summary: The note describes Chandler Mill Bridge, a historic steel bridge in Kennett Township, Chester County, Pennsylvania. It also carries the designation Chester County Bridge No. 236 and crosses the West Branch of Red Clay Creek. The bridge is a single-span, built-up steel plate girder structure constructed in 1910 with stone abutments and wingwalls.
one_line: Chandler Mill Bridge is a 1910 historic single-span steel plate girder bridge over the West Branch of Red Clay Creek in Chester County, Pennsylvania.
